lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with spatial intervals between 20-50 pixels depending on longitudinal position.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a primary grid of high-contrast nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal aspect and corresponding shadow casting on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the lower lateral flank and pectoral region by a high-density school of small, silver-toned teleost fish.
